name: Frigorific-Sabkha
description: Water rules this world utterly, kilometers deep over drowned continents. Swells march in orderly regiments until they shatter against frozen methane lakes, and the spray smells of minerals and cold salt.

The silence has texture, close to audible. Old survey teams left notes about hearing their own heartbeats as knocking. Extremophile bacteria thrive in the mineral seeps, painting slow, living terraces.
Geologists argue about the strata here: several layers appear deposited out of order, as if the planet's history were shuffled like cards.
Opportunity here wears armor. Claims on water, biomass, medicinal compounds and rare flora are staked, defended, and occasionally avenged, and the nearest law is a week's burn away.
